ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 75:25 ratio of low-intensity (black/grey) to high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels across the visible ventral area.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black pigmentation on distal tips and upper lobes; high-intensity white punctate spots and amorphous mottling concentrated along the trailing edges and the central peduncle-to-notch axis.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with an internal angle of approximately 45 degrees relative to the fluke centerline.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations. The left lobe exhibits 3-4 prominent high-amplitude peaks (5-10 pixels deep) while the right lobe displays lower-amplitude, more rounded serrations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical convex curvature extending laterally and upwards from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense clusters of high-contrast white circular scars (approx. 5-15 pixels in diameter) concentrated around the median notch and the central-lower portion of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple dark, intersecting linear streaks (rake marks) crossing the white mottled regions on the lower medial portions of both lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent traumatic indentation (missing tissue) on the far upper-outer boundary of the left fluke lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique pair of high-contrast white concentric ring-shaped markings located immediately to the right of the median notch.
